body: Current measured compile/runtime economics versus GCC:256 noinline functions compile medians **28.36/89.96/255.72ms** (Buster FAST/GCC O0/O2), median paired compiler ratios **3.17x/9.00x** favor Buster,12/12 each. Runtime **89.51/85.20/62.77ms**, paired O2 speedup **1.43x** favors GCC12/12. Text **26438/10004/5939B**, Buster4.45x O2. Roughly9 executions repay GCC O2's extra227ms compile cost for this input. Array-loop GCC O2 pays its extra~4.5ms compile time on the first execution. These distinct frontiers support an honest fast/release-quality policy; no default policy change is proposed. Existing shared FAST passes are present and native -O strings currently share FAST. The noinline fixture deliberately excludes inlining, so it does not measure an inliner prize. Respect #1973/#1976 phase/effort-policy research and #49 transform ownership. Evidence: Buster d4ca72fb4e97ae0a410b0d03258b00495fa45e13, trusted Clang21.1.8 Release; Ubuntu GCC15.2.0-16ubuntu1; hosted EPYC7763. Corrected [run37005475203](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/actions/runs/37005475203), diagnostic branch e19b531e03db62afd8f688ecd69d7f9f111283bf, artifact SHA256 `47c04b2c3f12e26c1346c4dbde0face10643dbc7a0256e364495a5686fec94ec` independently verified. Explicit baseline ISA, non-PIC/non-PIE, same GNU11/wrapv/alias/char semantics, common GCC CRT/linker,12 matched rounds/all six orders, all output/hash oracles passed. Stock GCC distro hardening retained; no isolated hardening/pass ablation. This is diagnostic, not Zen5/native-retirement acceptance. Full45-dimension report: [#2274](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/issues/2274#issuecomment-5952384555). License: Buster first-party license unselected (#621); GCC GPL-3.0-or-later with component-specific runtime terms. No external compiler source copied.
